name: Project Rebound
description: Project Rebound supports the higher education and successful reintegration of formerly incarcerated individuals wishing to enroll and succeed at the California State University. By connecting students with critical resources, Project Rebound provides an alternative to the revolving door of mass incarceration while strengthening community safety and resilience.
who_it_serves: Explicitly serves people on parole/probation or returning from incarceration (per program description)
